title: I do have some reoccurring locations but I also have a reoccurring person.
content: Not the usual reoccurring people who inhabit my dreams, family, friends, and even some insta models I must be following way too much but I have a reoccurring stranger that has been around since my childhood. We are usually imprisoned together by scary people, not for crimes, more of a kidnapping scenario. Many times I am trying to free him as he is the one confined. One time I even went to literal Hell and rescued him. He isn't regular, years can pass without him showing up, but when he does I immediately know it's him. Two things, I am attracted to him and I love him in every dream. Anyways I thought I would share. Thanks for inviting me to the group.
